description: List inbox conversations: replies to campaigns, sequences and transactional email, plus email sent to the inbox address (context.type inbox; recipientAddress says which address). Filter by status, search, unread, spam (only listed with spam true) or recipient, with pagination. Each conversation includes lastMessagePreview: a short plain-text preview of the latest subscriber or team reply (quoted history removed), or null.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

limit.description: Results per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

recipient.description: Only conversations that started at this inbox address.

search.description: Free-text search across conversation subjects and participants.

spam.description: Set true to list the Spam folder instead.

status.description: Filter by conversation status. Defaults to all.

unread.description: Set true to only return conversations with unread messages.

name: list_conversations

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_conversations` MCP tool.

conversations.description: List of inbox conversation records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
